notes.title: VideoHole: Episode II Demo Out Now!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36936042/67e2f4b917bd9d8dd20e286c822c2fa710cc37d8.png[/img]

It's been four years since you first were pushed into the mysterious VideoHole by your horrible boss, and it's finally time to see what's down there... sort of. The Trevor Demo of VideoHole: Episode II contains a full playthrough of just one of the many worlds you will visit inside this maze of your friends' insecurities and crushed dreams, all blown out to cinematic proportions! 

In this demo, you will explore the mind of Trevor, the introverted and at times irritating nepotism baby who has begrudgingly shared a workspace with you for as long as you can remember, but is that really all there is to this sad, helpless individual? Perhaps there's a little more going on in there than meets the eye. The world that Trevor has unwittingly projected onto this meta reality certainly seems to suggest so. Explore a vast forest, solve puzzles, and escape from an unstoppable cosmic terror as you race to return Trevor to reality!  

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3452100/VideoHole_Episode_II_Trevor_Demo/]Download For Free![/url]

notes.title: Our bad..
notes.notes:
Hello, 

We are Jofisoft, the developers of Videohole.

While we had originally planned on releasing this game on the 20th of November, we have had to make the difficult decision to push this date back. We are a three person team and we all do all this outside of full time jobs that are subject to changes in schedule and free time, so it is sometimes hard to accurately determine how long a specific task will take. Furthermore, the November release would have been sandwiched between two seasonal sales, which would have drastically reduced our initial visibility on Steam. 

We have been working on this game for almost three years, and want it to be as polished and complete as possible. For those of you that have been following us all this time, we’re grateful for your continued engagement and support. We plan on releasing the game in early 2025, almost exactly four years from the release of Videohole: Episode I. 

Thank you for your understanding. 

-Henry, Hollis, and Daniella.

notes.title: VideoHole Episode II Coming Soon!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36936042/b55b47378e4b844f6e666e9a9e4e0d2c16c1db9a.png[/img][h1]VideoHole Episode II Steam Page[/h1]

Unfortunately we were unable to finish episode II this past year. The game just kept getting bigger and we didn't want to cut anything.

[h2]The good news is that we're getting close! We even made a [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2269060/VideoHole_Episode_II/]steam page[/url] to prove it.[/h2]

So be a pal and head on over and give us a wishlist! The current plan is to have episode II out this spring, so cheer us on as we head towards victory!
